about: The style cards of the scenario sampler (specs/scenario-sampler.md), written by `notes style-cards --write`: version 1 (c-01 to c-40, 15 November 2026) and version 2 (s2-01 to s2-80, 17 November 2026: shorter and messier, no set formula for the parties). A card says how a note is written, never what it says; it names no claim type, element or polarity.

cards.text: Medium: 150 to 300 words in all. Tell the facts in the order they happened. Write numbered points. Use all four fields; "documents" as a list of the papers. Use nominal fragments rather than full verbs where you can. Write dates in the long form (في 12 من شهر مارس 2025). Where natural, give a sum in centimes as people say it (خمسون مليون سنتيم). When something did not happen, prefer «دون» or «بدون». When the other side tells its own version, prefer «يدعي» or «يزعم». Correct yourself once in the middle of the note, without changing any date or sum. Name each act with the concept the scenario gives for it, in your own Arabic, never with the usual set phrase. Write every year in full, with four digits.

Short: 60 to 150 words in all. Tell the facts in the order they happened. Write one block of text without paragraphs. Use "subject", "facts" and "requests"; leave "documents" empty. Speak of the client by name. Write the digits of dates and sums in Arabic-Indic digits (١٢/٠٣/٢٠٢٥). Write sums with points between thousands and the abbreviation of dinars (500.000 دج). Prefer verbs of refusal (امتنع، رفض، تخلف، تقاعس). When the other side tells its own version, prefer «يدعي» or «يزعم». Add one detail that does not matter to the case. Name each act with the concept the scenario gives for it, in your own Arabic, never with the usual set phrase. Write every year in full, with four digits.

Very short: two to four lines, 15 to 60 words in all. Start from the papers the client brought, then the facts they show. Write one block of text without paragraphs. Use "facts" and "requests"; leave "subject" and "documents" empty. Speak of the client by name. Write dates as day/month/year in digits (12/03/2025). Write sums with spaces between thousands and the word dinar (500 000 دينار). When something did not happen, say it with «عدم» and a noun. When the other side relies on its own version, prefer «يتمسك بـ» or «يدفع بـ». Add one reminder of a paper to ask the client for. Name each act with the words lawyers usually use for it. Write every year in full, with four digits.
